The in-place mp_add/mp_sub may grow their temporary (Std.mpAddHAv, Std.mpSubHAc), and so may the three mp_copy (Std.mpCopyGP, b of any size, InvmodSlowG.Res). theorem offG {pp : P} {mm : Mem} {rr : BitVec 64} (hP : GPre pp mm rr) (r : R) : Off (layG pp r) (Api.Invmod.hin pp) := by
  cases r
  · exact hP.off .stk
  · exact hP.off .aS
  · exact hP.off .aD
  · exact hP.off .bS
  · exact hP.off .bD
  · exact hP.off .cS
  · exact hP.off .cD
  · exact hP.off .code
  all_goals exact Off.nil _

theorem posG {pp : P} {mm : Mem} {rr : BitVec 64} (hP : GPre pp mm rr) (y : Y) :
    0 < (ρ3 pp y).len ∨ (ρ3 pp y).base < heapStart ∨ heapEnd ≤ (ρ3 pp y).base := by
  have := hP.res.apos; have := hP.res.bpos; have := hP.res.cpos
  rcases y with _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | r
  rotate_left 10
  · cases r
    · left; unfold ρ3; simp [Split.lay, layG_stk]
    · left; show 0 < 24; decide
    · left; show 0 < 4 * pp.a.alloc; omega
    · left; show 0 < 24; decide
    · left; show 0 < 4 * pp.b.alloc; omega
    · left; show 0 < 24; decide
    · left; show 0 < 4 * pp.c.alloc; omega
    · left; show 0 < textLen; decide
    all_goals (right; left; show Iv.nil.base < heapStart; decide)
  all_goals (left; unfold ρ3; simp [Split.lay, layG_stk])

/-- The heap checkpoint at the entry. -/
theorem entry_hp {pp : P} {mm : Mem} {rr : BitVec 64} (hP : GPre pp mm rr) :
    HP (ρX pp) wX (Api.Invmod.hin pp) (Api.Invmod.hin pp) (InAny (Api.Invmod.lay pp) Api.Invmod.ws) mm mm := by
  have hF : 256 ≤ (layG pp .stk).len := by rw [layG_stk]; exact (by decide : 256 ≤ 1232)
  have hstk : Ram (layG pp .stk).base (layG pp .stk).len := (hP.bund .stk).2
  refine HP.entry hP.heap (fun y => (offG hP (proj y)).sub (sub3 hF y) (posG hP y)) ?_ ?_
  · intro y hy q hq
    have hs := sub3 hF y
    have hq2 : (ρ3 pp y).In q := hq
    have hq' : (layG pp (proj y)).In q := by unfold Iv.Sub Iv.In at *; omega
    rcases y with _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | r
    rotate_left 10
    · cases r
      · exact InAny.of_mem (w := Api.Invmod.R.stk) (by decide) hq'
      · simp [wX, w3, Split.wr, isW] at hy
      · simp [wX, w3, Split.wr, isW] at hy
      · simp [wX, w3, Split.wr, isW] at hy
      · simp [wX, w3, Split.wr, isW] at hy
      · exact InAny.of_mem (w := Api.Invmod.R.cS) (by decide) hq'
      · exact InAny.of_mem (w := Api.Invmod.R.cD) (by decide) hq'
      · simp [wX, w3, Split.wr, isW] at hy
      all_goals (exfalso; have h1 : 0x80000000 ≤ q := hq'.1; have h2 : q < 0x80000000 + 0 := hq'.2; omega)
    all_goals exact InAny.of_mem (w := Api.Invmod.R.stk) (by decide) hq'
  · intro y hy
    have hs := sub3 hF y
    rcases y with _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | r
    rotate_left 10
    · cases r
      · exact Ram.sub hstk hs.1 hs.2
      · simp [wX, w3, Split.wr, isW] at hy
      · simp [wX, w3, Split.wr, isW] at hy
      · simp [wX, w3, Split.wr, isW] at hy
      · simp [wX, w3, Split.wr, isW] at hy
      · show Ram pp.pc 24
        simpa [Layout.sizeofMpInt] using (Hdr.geom (show Hdr mm pp.pc pp.cdp pp.c from (hP.bund .cS).2)).st
      · show Ram pp.cdp (4 * pp.c.alloc)
        exact (show Dig mm pp.cdp pp.c.alloc pp.c.digit from (hP.bund .cD).2).ram
      · simp [wX, w3, Split.wr, isW] at hy
      all_goals exact Ram.nil
    all_goals exact Ram.sub hstk hs.1 hs.2
